context: Sunday lunch at the elder Hiroshi's house. Hiroshi Yamada (boss) is the son; Hiroshi Kato (retired professor) is the father. They share a name — and a quiet. Today the son has brought news he's been delaying for weeks.
purpose: long-deferred confessional — adult son to elder father, the conversation he has been rehearsing for two years

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 父さん、ちょっと話があって。
lines.en: Dad — there's something I want to talk about.
lines.style: Stiff opening. Each word rehearsed and picked carefully. The phrasing of someone who has practiced this in the car. Formal register.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ああ、座りなさい。お茶、飲むか。
lines.en: Mm — sit down. Will you have some tea?
lines.style: No surprise. Already pouring. The kettle was on for a reason. Understated and knowing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Restless energy barely contained in stillness. The body wants to move even as the voice holds steady.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 忙しいんだろう。座って、まず一杯。
lines.en: You're busy, I know. Sit — one cup first.
lines.style: Slow, deliberate. The chair being pulled out is the actual response. A small act of insistence wrapped in gentleness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: The chair takes his weight. A long breath released, almost involuntary. A body surrendering what the voice hasn't yet.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.style: Single word. Full attention. The room narrows. What comes next is important and he is ready.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 実は、会社、辞めようかと。
lines.en: Truth is — I'm thinking of leaving the company.
lines.style: The quietest he has ever been. Speaking something he hasn't said aloud before. The sentence sits exposed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.style: A long silence — long enough that the listener feels it. No surprise visible. A father processing his son's weight.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Half-relieved, half-asking. A son testing whether his father already knew. Seeking recognition and confession at once.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.style: Two separate truths divided by a pause. Honest admission followed by the wisdom of patience. Clear and dignified.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ずっと、考えてた。本当に長く。
lines.en: I've been thinking about it. Really, for a long time.
lines.style: A long breath. The words after "really" carry two years of sleepless nights. The thought has weight.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.style: Plain, direct question. No accusation in it. Just genuinely curious. The tone of a man who wants facts.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: The number is the heaviest thing in the sentence. It lands like a confession. A pause before or after it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.style: Repeats the number to hold it properly. Gentle recognition without judgment. The fatherly understanding of duration.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 父さんに、最初に言うべきだった。
lines.en: I should have told you first.
lines.style: The smallest line in the conversation. A confession underneath the confession. Almost whispered shame and regret.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.style: Firm. The gift of the answer he didn't expect. Simple and absolute. The release of something the son has been carrying.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: A breath of release. The voice catches half a step, emotion breaking through. The wall coming down.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 私だって、お前の年の頃、迷った。
lines.en: When I was your age — I was lost too.
lines.style: A piece of his own history volunteered for the first time. Quiet. Vulnerable in the way only fathers can be when they finally let their children see them.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Genuine surprise. Looks up in the voice for the first time. The father becomes human. Wonder and recognition at once.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: うん。…で、辞めて、何をするんだ。
lines.en: Yes. …So if you leave — what will you do?
lines.style: Patient and genuinely curious. The conversation pivoting toward what comes next. The question asked without pressure.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: それも、まだ、決まってなくて。
lines.en: That part — I haven't decided yet.
lines.style: Honest admission. A faint embarrassed laugh in the voice. Lighter than before because he's been heard.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: いいんだ。時間はある。お茶、もう一杯。
lines.en: That's fine. There's time. Another cup of tea.
lines.style: Closing line in the most fatherly cadence he has. Permission and presence at once. Pours slowly, deliberately, with care.
